'''John Trouba''' won the [[1997 Bespin Regionals (Minneapolis)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"Age 34. Married to a beautiful lady with whom I enjoy dabbling in the outdoors and watching movies. I am involved in local political campaigns and neighborhood improvement organizations. I work as a community development consultant assisting counties, villages and cities with community and economic development activities. My favorite actor is Alec Guinness. My favorite character is Sidney Reilly from the PBS series ''Reilly:Ace of Spies'' (played by Sam Neill). I look forward to the Finals and meeting the folks at Decipher."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/trouba.html John Trouba], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428115615/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/trouba.html Internet Archive]</ref>
